card.name: Community-involvement terms in development writing
card.fires_on: Words in or right after 'community' phrases about local participation, such as community contribution, community policing council, mobilisation and participatory governance. Also nearby words in local-committee or resident-consultation settings.

modes.label: After 'community'
modes.description: The word that follows 'community' or the community itself in funding or policing bodies.

modes.label: Mobilisation and participation
modes.description: Parts of words like mobilising or participatory in talk of involving local people.
